Problem

Consulting teams need a centralized system to handle client requests, appointment bookings, project updates, and PIC communications without switching between tools.

Overview

Ganeshlab Consultation is an integrated project management and consulting platform specifically designed to bridge communication between clients, Person in Charge (PIC), and admins in a single, structured workflow. This platform offers a solution to the classic problem of consulting teams often having to juggle multiple applications—such as separate chat, calendar, and tracker apps—just to manage a single consulting project. With an all-in-one approach, this application combines appointment booking features integrated with Google Calendar, project progress tracking, and a real-time chat system. Built using modern technologies like Next.js and TypeScript, and containerized with Docker, this platform ensures fast, secure, and scalable performance to simplify team and client collaboration.

Approach

  1. / 01Building a structured consulting workflow for clients, PICs, and admins.
  2. / 02Combines appointment booking, project tracking, and chat in one integrated dashboard.

Outcome

  • Project consultation and coordination processes are faster and more organized.
  • Clients and project managers can monitor the status of meetings, projects, and follow-ups in one place.

Features

  • Authentication
  • Google Calendar
  • Realtime Message
  • Realtime Notification
